gateBoundary.allowedUse: Visualize X2 bone-length preservation and local triangle constraints in the existing low-detail blockout.

interpretation.boneEdges: Anatomical bone segment rows should remain near zero; these are the no-stretch evidence.
interpretation.foldingDiagonals: Diagonal rows such as shoulder->wrist and elbow->forepaw are expected to change as the limb folds; they are visual triangle constraints, not fixed bones.
interpretation.formalTriangulation: These diagnostic triangles are not layer boundaries, not Delaunay output, and not ArtMesh topology.
